title: Compat API v1.54: GET /images/json?identity=
body:
Docker Engine API [v1.54](https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/engine/version-history/#v154-api-changes) has one remaining Compat gap before we can treat 1.54 as covered under the parent epic (claim v1.55).
## Needs work
### `GET /images/json?identity=`
- When `identity` is set, include manifest summaries and may include per-manifest `Identity`.
- Moby client typically sets both `manifests=1` and `identity=1`.
- Today Compat list does not parse `identity`/`manifests`, and the list summary type has no `Manifests` / `Identity` / `Descriptor`.
- Depends on the same identity/origin plumbing as v1.53 image-inspect `Identity` (and optional experimental manifests).
## Checklist
- [ ] `GET /images/json?identity=` (manifest summaries + optional Identity)
## Contributing
If you want to work on this checklist item, please open a focused issue (or PR) and reference **this** issue (and the parent epic). Coordinate with the v1.53 Identity work if splitting.
